title: Accumulation points of congruence densities of finite lattices
summary: Let $\mathcal W$ be a nontrivial variety of lattices, and let $L$ be a finite lattice in $\mathcal W$. The congruence density of $L$ with respect to $\mathcal W$ is the number of congruences of $L$ divided by the maximum number of congruences of $|L|$-element lattices belonging to $\mathcal W$. We prove that, with respect to the order and multiplication of the real numbers, the set SCD$(\mathcal W)$ of congruence densities of finite members of $\mathcal W$ as well as its topological closure are countably infinite dually well-ordered monoids.
